title: IDS-ReComm: per-run model predictions for a 1,500-run evaluation of IDS datasets and models
description:
Model outputs for all 1,500 experimental runs reported in "A Comprehensive Evaluation of IDS Datasets and Models with a Derived Framework for Informed Dataset Selection: IDS-ReComm".

Five classical machine learning models and five deep learning models were evaluated across four benchmark intrusion detection datasets (NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, HIKARI-2021) plus one identifier-removal ablation variant, under six configurations per dataset, repeated over five random seeds. Every transform, including recursive feature elimination, was fitted on training data alone.

The archive contains one compressed NumPy file per run, holding the ground-truth labels, predicted labels and predicted probabilities over the held-out test split. Any metric reported in the paper can be recomputed from these arrays without retraining, including metrics the paper does not report.

The four source datasets are not redistributed; their licences rest with their original providers. Code, aggregated metrics, statistical output and figures are available in the accompanying GitHub repository.
